evidence.detail: uniqify_cards() deduplicates by card.canonicalize(c.name) only, so [[Vindicate|G07]] and [[Vindicate|J13]] collapse to one entry — preferred_printing is set on the card but ignored by the dedup key
copy_with_mode() stores preferred_printing on the Card object — the information is present but unused during dedup
post_cards() calls uniqify_cards(cards) before rendering — all duplicates removed here

triage.fix_sketch: In discordbot/command.py:214-216, change the deduplication key from card.canonicalize(c.name) to card.canonicalize(c.name) + '|' + (c.get('preferred_printing') or '') — this lets multiple explicit set-code printings of the same card appear while still deduplicating unqualified duplicate mentions of the same card.
triage.notes: One-line change. Edge case: if the same printing is mentioned twice it will still deduplicate correctly (same key). Existing tests in discordbot/command_test.py should be checked and a case added for multiple printings.
